name: Formoterol
executiveSummary: Long-acting β2 agonist (LABA) with rapid onset. Adult: **12 µg q12h** inhaled (usual max **24–48 µg/day** per label). Prefer **combination with ICS**. No monotherapy in asthma.
indications:
## Indications

- Asthma (always with inhaled corticosteroid) and COPD (maintenance).
- MART regimens (budesonide/formoterol maintenance + reliever) per GINA/combo label.

## Precautions

- **Not** sole asthma therapy (↑ severe exacerbations).
- Tremor, tachycardia, hypokalemia; caution in heart disease.
- Does not replace SABA rescue unless authorized MART regimen.

> Check inhaler technique and ICS adherence.

adulto.dose: Maintenance formoterol alone (COPD/asthma with separate ICS): **12 µg q12h** (usual max **24 µg/day**; some labels up to **48 µg/day**). Combos: follow each component (e.g. Symbicort 160/4.5).
adulto.administration: Inhaled; rinse if ICS in same device.

pediatrico.dose: ≥6–12 y: only in authorized combination (e.g. budesonide/formoterol) — dose per product label. No LABA alone.

stability:
## Stability

- Store device per label; protect DPI from moisture.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Tremor, palpitations, headache, cramps; rare: arrhythmia, hypokalemia.
